title: cerasus × subhirtella
intro: Cerasus × subhirtella, commonly known as Japanese flowering cherry, is a deciduous tree or shrub that belongs to the Prunus genus. This plant is known for its vibrant pink or white flowers and is often used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Japanese flowering cherry include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against infections and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative, anti-anxiety, and cardiovascular-protective effects.
